q: Here is Vohu-Manô, my creature, O Zarathustra!

s: Ahura Mazda creates Asha-Vahista
q: here is Asha-Vahista, my creature, O Zarathustra!

s: Ahura Mazda creates Khsathra-Vairya
q: here is Khsathra-Vairya, my creature, O Zarathustra!

s: Ahura Mazda creates Spenta-Ârmaiti
q: here is Spenta-Ârmaiti, my creature, O Zarathustra!

s: Ahura Mazda knows the goodness of all beings worshipped in holiness
q: All those beings of whom Ahura Mazda knows the goodness for a sacrifice [performed] in holiness, all those beings, males and females, do we worship.

s: Ahura Mazda is worthy of sacrifice and prayer
q: Verily, when I created Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, O Spitama! I created him as worthy of sacrifice, as worthy of prayer as myself, Ahura Mazda.

s: those who lie unto Mithra are punished by Mithra (with loss of strength, swiftness, eyesight, and hearing)
q: Thou bringest down terror upon the bodies of the men who lie unto Mithra; thou takest away the strength from their arms, being angry and all-powerful; thou takest the swiftness from their feet, the eye-sight from their eyes, the hearing from their ears.

s: contract must not be broken Mithra (whether made with faithful or unfaithful)
q: Break not the contract, O Spitama! neither the one that thou hadst entered into with one of the unfaithful, nor the one that thou hadst entered into with one of the faithful who is one of thy own faith.

s: material world is extended over by a dwelling (wide as the earth)
q: Whose dwelling, wide as the earth, extends over the material world, large, unconfined, and bright, a far-and-wide-extending abode.

s: Mithra is a god (powerful and all-knowing)
q: he, of the ten thousand spies, the powerful, all-knowing, undeceivable god.

s: Mithra has good glory
q: Whose renown is good, whose shape is good, whose glory is good;

s: Mithra gives boons (at his will)
q: who has boons to give at his will, who has pasture-fields to give at his will;

s: Mithra gives pasture-fields (at his will)
q: who has boons to give at his will, who has pasture-fields to give at his will;

s: Mithra is harmless to tiller of the ground (beneficent)
q: harmless to the tiller of the ground, . . . ., beneficent;

s: Mithra withholds strength (from those who lie unto Mithra)
q: Who gives neither strength nor vigour to him who has lied unto Mithra;

s: Mithra withholds glory (from those who lie unto Mithra)
q: who gives neither glory nor any boon to him who has lied unto Mithra.

s: Mithra protects those who lie not (as keeper and maintainer)
q: Thou art a keeper and protector of the dwelling of those who lie not: thou art the maintainer of those who lie not.

s: Mithra is invoked by king (lord of the country, with hands uplifted)
q: Whom the lord of the country invokes for help, with hands uplifted;

s: Mithra is invoked by poor man (when wronged and deprived of his rights)
q: Whom the poor man, who follows the good law, when wronged and deprived of his rights, invokes for help, with hands uplifted.

s: Mithra is invoked by cow (when driven astray and longing for the stables)
q: The cow driven astray invokes him for help, longing for the stables:

s: Mithra has epithet lord of wide pastures
q: We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, . . . . sleepless, and ever awake;

s: Mithra has friendship with Verethraghna (the best of all friendships)
q: With thee hath Verethraghna, made by Ahura, contracted the best of all friendships,

s: Mithra is accompanied by Sraosha (holy and powerful)
q: Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, goes and yokes his horses to his chariot, along with the holy, powerful Sraosha and Nairyô-sangha,

s: Mithra is accompanied by Nairyô-sangha (with Sraosha)
q: Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, goes and yokes his horses to his chariot, along with the holy, powerful Sraosha and Nairyô-sangha,

s: Mithra has chariot (high-wheeled and made of a heavenly substance)
q: Who drives along on his high-wheeled chariot, made of a heavenly substance,

s: Mithra has horses (four heavenly, white, shining, beneficent, and knowledgeable steeds)
q: whom four heavenly steeds, white, shining, seen afar, beneficent, endowed with knowledge, swiftly carry along the heavenly space,

s: Mithra travels between Karshvares (from Arezahi to Hvaniratha)
q: Who drives along on his high-wheeled chariot, made of a heavenly substance, from the Karshvare of Arezahi to the Karshvare of Hvaniratha, the bright one;

s: Mithra is protected by Law of Mazda (which opens a way for him)
q: to whom the Law of Mazda opens a way, that he may go easily;

s: Mithra is worshipped with sacrifice (invoked by his own name and with proper words)
q: With a sacrifice, in which thou art invoked by thy own name, with the proper words will I offer thee libations, O powerful Mithra!

s: Mithra accepts libations (as consecrated)
q: Accept our libations! Accept them as they have been consecrated!

s: Mithra is sleepless ever awake
q: We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, . . . . sleepless, and ever awake;

s: Ahura Mazda is a Maker (of the dwelling on the Hara Berezaiti)
q: For whom the Maker, Ahura Mazda, has built up a dwelling on the Hara Berezaiti,

s: Ahura Mazda confers mastership him (of the world)
q: The holy Ahura Mazda confessed that religion and so did Vohu-Manô, so did Asha-Vahista, so did Khshathra-Vairya, so did Spenta-Ârmaiti, so did Haurvatât and Ameretât; and all the Amesha-Spentas longed for and confessed his religion. The kind Mazda conferred upon him the mastership of the world;

s: Hara Berezaiti is a bright mountain (around which the stars revolve)
q: a dwelling on the Hara Berezaiti, the bright mountain around which the many (stars) revolve,

s: Hara Berezaiti is free from night and darkness
q: where come neither night nor darkness, no cold wind and no hot wind, no deathful sickness, no uncleanness made by the Daêvas,

s: Amesha-Spentas make Mithra's dwelling (in one accord with the sun and in the fulness of faith)
q: A dwelling that all the Amesha-Spentas, in one accord with the sun, made for him in the fulness of faith of a devoted heart,

s: Daêvas are fled by Mithra (in fear)
q: From whom all the Daêvas unseen and the Varenya fiends flee away in fear.

s: Mithra has dwelling Mithra's dwelling (on the Hara Berezaiti)
q: A dwelling that all the Amesha-Spentas, in one accord with the sun, made for him in the fulness of faith of a devoted heart, and he surveys the whole of the material world from the Haraiti Bareza.

s: Daêvas are associated with malice
q: may smite all the malice of Daêvas and Men, of the Yâtus and Pairikas,

s: Haoma is a lordly (enlivening, healing, fair, and golden-eyed)
q: To whom the enlivening, healing, fair, lordly, golden-eyed Haoma offered up a sacrifice on the highest of the heights,

s: Haoma offers sacrifice to Mithra (on the Haraiti Bareza)
q: To whom the enlivening, healing, fair, lordly, golden-eyed Haoma offered up a sacrifice on the highest of the heights, on the Haraiti Bareza,

s: sacrifice is offered to Mithra (for his brightness and glory)
q: For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth being heard . . . .

s: faithful receive help (from Mithra when he is satisfied with them)
q: And to him with whom Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, has been satisfied, he comes with help;

s: those who lie unto Mithra lose strength (from Mithra)
q: Who gives neither strength nor vigour to him who has lied unto Mithra;

s: those who lie unto Mithra lose glory (from Mithra)
q: who gives neither glory nor any boon to him who has lied unto Mithra.

s: Rashnu Razista has dwelling a dwelling
q: Who made a dwelling for Rashnu, and to whom Rashnu gave all his soul for long friendship;

s: Verethraghna has friendship with Mithra (the best of all friendships)
q: With thee hath Verethraghna, made by Ahura, contracted the best of all friendships,

s: Law of Mazda opens way for Mithra (so that he may go easily)
q: to whom the Law of Mazda opens a way, that he may go easily;

s: Mithra surveys material world (from the Hara Berezaiti)
q: A dwelling that all the Amesha-Spentas, in one accord with the sun, made for him in the fulness of faith of a devoted heart, and he surveys the whole of the material world from the Haraiti Bareza.

s: religion is confessed by Ahura Mazda (as Mithra's religion)
q: The holy Ahura Mazda confessed that religion

s: Vohu-Manô confesses religion (Mithra's religion)
q: and so did Vohu-Manô,

s: Asha-Vahista confesses religion (Mithra's religion)
q: so did Asha-Vahista,

s: Spenta-Ârmaiti confesses religion (Mithra's religion)
q: so did Spenta-Ârmaiti,

s: Haurvatât confesses religion (Mithra's religion)
q: so did Haurvatât

s: Vîdôtu is made by Daêvas (fiendish)
q: wherein the evil-doing Aêshma rushes along with Vîdôtu, made by the Daêvas.

s: Mithra is keeper of all creatures (kind)
q: I am the kind keeper of all creatures, I am the kind maintainer of all creatures;

s: Mithra is maintainer of all creatures (kind)
q: I am the kind keeper of all creatures, I am the kind maintainer of all creatures;

s: Mithra has ten thousand spies (all-knowing and undeceivable)
q: he, of the ten thousand spies, the powerful, all-knowing, undeceivable god.

s: Mithra has good renown
q: Whose renown is good, whose shape is good, whose glory is good;

s: Mithra is a god (holy and heavenly)
q: Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, never smite us in his anger; he who stands up upon this earth as the strongest of all gods, the most valiant of all gods, the most energetic of all gods, the swiftest of all gods, the most fiend-smiting of all gods, he, Mithra, the lord

s: Mithra is feared by Bûshyãsta (who flees away in fear)
q: from whom the long-handed Bûshyãsta flees away in fear;

s: Mithra is feared by Daêvas (unseen)
q: from whom all the Daêvas unseen and the Varenya fiends flee away in fear.

s: Daêvas is unseen unseen (all)
q: from whom all the Daêvas unseen and the Varenya fiends flee away in fear.

s: Mithra is feared by Varenya fiends
q: from whom all the Daêvas unseen and the Varenya fiends flee away in fear.

s: Mithra is assisted by Sraosha (at his right hand)
q: At his right hand drives the good, holy Sraosha;

s: Sraosha is a good, holy being (driving at Mithra's right hand)
q: At his right hand drives the good, holy Sraosha;

s: Mithra is assisted by Rashnu Razista (at his left hand)
q: at his left hand drives the tall and strong Rashnu;

s: Rashnu Razista is tall and strong tall and strong
q: at his left hand drives the tall and strong Rashnu;

s: Mithra is surrounded by Fravashis of the faithful (on all sides)
q: on all sides around him drive the waters, the plants, and the Fravashis of the faithful.

s: Mithra is sleepless ever awake
q: We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, . . . . sleepless, and ever awake;

s: Mithra maintains the creation of Mazda (wakefully and without sleeping)
q: who, never sleeping, wakefully guards the creation of Mazda; who, never sleeping, wakefully maintains the creation of Mazda.
